changelog: v1.5.2: Allow official Indian government apps (including Kerala Police com.keralapolice, in.gov.*, and com.nic.*) only when verified from Play Store.

windows.changelog: v2.8.2: A temporary approval no longer disappears while the program is still running. A 'this run' answer was bound to the single process that asked, so a browser lost it - and its rule - as soon as one helper process exited, and the 900 second limit could end it mid-session; it now follows the program and expires only when the program is gone, and an expiry never cuts a live connection. The saved-permissions screen was rebuilt as one card per program (verdict pill, lifetime in plain words, Allow/Block/Remove on the card) with a Recent changes strip explaining what just changed.
